verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community comment saying Chargebee natively lets you configure VAT rates and choose whether VAT is included in prices or added to the invoice amount. There is no first-party tax documentation, and nothing covers sales tax, GST, registrations, automatic rate determination, or a first-class tax integration. missing for 10: first-party tax docs, sales tax and GST calculation, tax registration management, automatic jurisdiction rate lookup, first-class tax-engine integration, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates

citations.quote: So Chargebee allows you to configure VAT rates and whether to include VAT in the prices or add it to the invoice amount.
